title: UPPER PUSH & POSTURE
subtitle: TUESDAY EASE. GENTLE PRESS. SOFT POSTURE.

script.welcome: Hello Pam. I'm Stratton. Tuesday is gentle upper push and soft posture — a small break from the desk, nothing fierce. About eleven minutes. If a joint is sore, take a smaller range. Showing up is the win.
script.start: Whenever you're ready. Easy breath. This is meant to feel doable.
script.nextExercise: Next one. Shake it out if you like. No rush.
script.rest: Have a little rest. Breathe easy.
script.lastSet: Last set. Make it comfortable and clean.
script.complete: That's us. Lovely work. Soft press, a bit of posture, and you showed up. Enjoy your day — see you tomorrow.
script.resume: Back with you. Easy as we go.

exercises.name: WALL PUSH UPS
exercises.cue: Stand facing a wall, feet a comfortable step back, hands on the wall at about shoulder height. Soft belly. Bend the elbows and ease the chest toward the wall, then press away with control. Keep the range small and kind. Empty hands are perfect. Smaller depth is fine on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Wall push ups. Two sets of six. Hands on the wall, soft belly, ease in and press away. Keep the range small and kind.
exercises.speakRest: Thirty seconds. Shake the arms. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Wall push ups done. Nicely done.

exercises.name: SEATED OVERHEAD PRESS
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair. Soft belly. Light hand weights optional — empty hands are fine. Start with hands at about shoulder height and press gently upward only as high as feels kind, then lower with control. Soft on the shoulders and neck. Smaller range is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated overhead press. Two sets of six. Sit tall, soft belly, press gently upward only as high as feels kind, then lower. Empty hands are fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty five seconds. Soften the shoulders.

exercises.name: SEATED ROW
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair. Soft belly. Elbows soft at your sides. Draw the elbows gently back as if squeezing a soft cushion between the shoulder blades, then ease forward. Light weights optional. Keep the neck soft. Smaller squeeze is fine on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated row. Two sets of eight. Sit tall, soft belly, draw the elbows gently back, then ease forward. Soft on the neck.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty five seconds. Soften the upper back.

exercises.name: CHAIR BALANCE
exercises.cue: Stand beside a sturdy chair, light hand on the backrest. Softly shift weight onto one foot and lift the other heel or foot a little. Hold about twenty seconds, then switch. Use the chair as much as you need. Soft tall posture, easy breath. Smaller hold is fine on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Chair balance. Two sets of about twenty seconds each side. Light hand on the chair, soft weight on one foot, lift the other a little. Use the chair as much as you need.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Shake it out. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Balance done. That's the session — lovely work.
